newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine halts tax breaks for charities' imports.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine halts tax breaks for charities' imports.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma has signed a law cancelling tax breaks on imported goods brought into the country by charitable groups including humanitarian aid and technical assistance organisations.
The new law, adopted earlier this month by parliament, was made public at the weekend and will take effect in January.
The move is part of Ukraine's attempts to pay off the country's $1.6 billion wage debt and to halt corruption.
Many businesses, under the guise of charities, have imported goods into Ukraine without paying customs duties.
Citizens retain the right to import up to $1,400 in goods without being charged duties.
